extraction.document_summary: Singlife Whole Life Choice is a whole life protection plan (Base Cover plus an Additional Cover) designed to provide lifelong coverage for death and Terminal Illness. The brochure states that on Terminal Illness diagnosis, the Terminal Illness Benefit is paid as an advance payment of the Death Benefit (less amounts owing), in a lump sum. The Base Cover also accumulates cash value and bonuses from the start of the third policy year. You can customise protection by choosing the Additional Cover amount as 100% / 200% / 300% / 400% of the Base Sum Assured, with the Additional Cover lasting until a selected Additional Cover Age (65, 70, 75, 80 or 85) and then reducing by 12.5% each year over eight years. Living features include a Life Stage Withdrawal Benefit (withdraw accumulated reversionary bonuses up to two times; subject to conditions), a Retrenchment Benefit (premium waiver up to 12 months after a waiting period and unemployment criteria), and an Income Payout Option that converts policy cash value to monthly payouts from age 65 or end of premium term (whichever is later). Eligible key milestones can also be used for a Guaranteed Extra Protection Option (no insurability; limited to 100% of Base Sum Assured / up to S$500,000).

policies.quick_summary: A Singlife whole life protection plan with lifelong death and Terminal Illness cover, cash value accumulation, and living benefits such as Life Stage Withdrawal, Retrenchment premium waiver, and an Income Payout option. It includes a Base Cover (lifetime) plus an Additional Cover that can be set at 100%/200%/300%/400% of Base Sum Assured and reduces after the selected Additional Cover Age (65/70/75/80/85). Other key features include the Guaranteed Extra Protection Option at certain life events (no insurability), and premium payment term choices (10/15/20/25 years or pay until age 65). Rely on the policy’s product summary for full benefit details of the attached riders.
coverage_scope: Terminal Illness (as advance of Death Benefit)
Cash value and bonuses under Base Cover
Living benefits/options: Life Stage Withdrawal Benefit, Retrenchment Benefit premium waiver, Income Payout Option, Guaranteed Extra Protection Option
Ability to add named riders listed in the brochure
policies.residency_requirements: Resides in Singapore is mentioned only in an illustration (May’s profile); no stated eligibility requirement for the policy.
policies.coverage_term_description: Base Cover provides lifelong protection against death and Terminal Illness. Additional Cover lasts until the selected Additional Cover Age (65, 70, 75, 80 or 85) and then decreases by 12.5% each year over eight years, after which coverage continues without Additional Cover.
policies.premium_payment_term_description: Choose from 10, 15, 20, or 25 years, or pay until age 65.
policies.bonuses_or_dividends: Base Cover accumulates guaranteed and non-guaranteed cash value; non-guaranteed cash value is accumulated via reversionary bonus (declared annually) and Terminal Bonus, depending on Participating Fund performance.
policy_termination_events: Conversion to Reduced Paid-Up (RPU) or Extended Term Insurance (ETI) makes the Life Stage Withdrawal Benefit not applicable (per Important notes).
important_caveats: Life Stage Withdrawal Benefit: can be exercised up to two times; application must be submitted within 90 days of the life stage event; option is subject to conditions and not applicable if the basic policy has been converted to Reduced Paid-Up (RPU) or Extended Term Insurance (ETI).
Life Stage Withdrawal Benefit: not applicable if the basic policy has been converted to RPU or ETI.

Retrenchment Benefit: available once per policy; waiver applies up to 12 months after involuntary unemployment for three consecutive months, subject to waiting period and exclusions in circumstances (e.g., retirement/resignation/known layoffs).

Guaranteed Extra Protection Option: limited total coverage under option to 100% of Base Sum Assured or up to a maximum of S$500,000 per life (whichever is lower), and is extended to standard life only.
Terminal Illness advance payment: Terminal Illness Benefit is paid as advance payment of the Death Benefit, less amounts owing.

benefits.benefit_name: Terminal Illness Benefit (advance of Death Benefit)
benefits.benefit_description: Provides an advance payment of the Death Benefit upon Terminal Illness diagnosis (less amounts owing).
benefits.trigger_description: Upon diagnosis of Terminal Illness of the Life Assured.
benefits.payout_basis: advance payment of the Death Benefit, less any amount owing
benefits.payout_description: Terminal Illness Benefit is paid as an advance payment of the Death Benefit, less any amount owing, in one lump sum.

evidence.quote:
Upon diagnosis of Terminal Illness of the Life Assured, Singapore Life Ltd. will pay the Terminal Illness Benefit
as an advance payment of the Death Benefit, less any amount owing to Singapore Life Ltd., in one lump sum.

benefits.benefit_description: Allows withdrawals of accumulated reversionary bonuses during eligible life stage events, without surrender charges (subject to conditions).
benefits.trigger_description: Eligible life stage events occur before the policy anniversary when the Life Assured reaches age 65 at next birthday; withdrawal is exercised up to two times during the lifetime of the Life Assured.
covered_conditions: Becoming a parent (newborn or legal adoption)
Enrolment into tertiary education (Life Assured or Life Assured’s child)
benefits.payout_basis: accumulated reversionary bonuses available balance/available balance subject to minimum
benefits.payout_description: Policyholder may withdraw accumulated reversionary bonuses without charges; minimum withdrawal amount is S$1,000 in multiples of $10 or the available balance.
benefits.claim_frequency: Up to two times during the lifetime of the Life Assured
benefits.benefit_expiry_description: Option can be exercised up to two times provided that the life stage event occurs before the policy anniversary when the Life Assured reaches age 65 at the next birthday.
benefits.notes: Application must be submitted within 90 days of the life stage event; not applicable if basic policy has been converted to Reduced Paid-Up (RPU) or Extended Term Insurance (ETI).

evidence.quote: The Policyholder may exercise the Life Stage Withdrawal Benefit to withdraw accumulated reversionary bonuses without charges, subject to the following conditions:

The option can be exercised up to two times during the lifetime of the Life Assured, provided that the life stage event occurs before the policy anniversary when the Life Assured
reaches age 65 at the next birthday. The application must be submitted within 90 days of the life stage event. The minimum withdrawal amount is S$1,000 (in multiples of $10) or the
available balance.
This option is not applicable if the basic policy has been converted to Reduced Paid-Up (RPU) or Extended Term Insurance (ETI).

Eligible life stage events include:
a) any change of marital status of the Life Assured (i.e. marries, divorces or is widowed)
b) the Life Assured becomes a parent by having a newborn child, or legally adopts a child (i.e. adding a new child member to the Life Assured’s immediate family)
c) the Life Assured purchases a property
d) the Life Assured or Life Assured’s child enrols into tertiary education

benefits.benefit_description: Waives premiums for up to 12 months after involuntary unemployment criteria are met (subject to waiting period and conditions).
benefits.trigger_description: Life Assured is involuntarily unemployed for three consecutive months; benefit becomes available once per policy for Life Assured aged 17 or older.
benefits.payout_basis: premium waiver for up to 12 months on basic policy and all supplementary benefits; premiums paid during waiver period will be refunded
benefits.payout_description: Waives premiums on the basic policy and all supplementary benefits for up to 12 months after involuntarily unemployed for three consecutive months; premiums paid during waiver period will be refunded and payments resume after waiver period ends. Conditions apply and unemployment must not result from listed circumstances.
benefits.benefit_start_description: Available once per policy; must be used before Life Assured reaches age 65; application within six months of unemployment.
benefits.benefit_expiry_description: Benefit must be exercised before the Life Assured reaches age 65.
benefits.notes: Waiting period of six months from policy inception applies before this benefit can be used. Not available for retirement, resignation, stress-related issues, contract expiration, or anticipated layoffs known prior to policy start date.

evidence.quote:
Retrenchment Benefit is available once per policy for Life Assured aged 17 or older, waives premiums on the basic policy and all supplementary benefits for up to 12 months after the
Life Assured is involuntarily unemployed for three consecutive months.

The application must be submitted within six months of unemployment, and proof of job termination or closure
(for self-employed individuals) is required.
A six-month waiting period from policy inception applies before this benefit can be used.

Conditions apply, including that the unemployment must not result from retirement, resignation, stress-related
issues, contract expiration, or anticipated layoffs known prior to the policy start date.
This benefit must be exercised before the Life Assured reaches age 65.

benefits.benefit_name: Income Payout Option (monthly payouts from cash value)
benefits.benefit_description: Converts the policy’s cash value into monthly payouts payable to the Life Assured until age 99, subject to when exercised and minimum monthly income requirement.
benefits.trigger_description: Policyholder may exercise at each monthly anniversary date starting from (i) policy anniversary when Life Assured is age 65, or (ii) end of premium payment term, whichever is later; monthly income starts one month after option is exercised.
covered_conditions: Policy has accumulated cash value (cash value under policy)
benefits.payout_basis: policy cash value conversion into monthly payouts
benefits.payout_description: Monthly payouts payable to you until you reach age 99; monthly income starts one month after option is exercised and must meet minimum monthly income requirement.
benefits.benefit_start_description: From each monthly anniversary date starting from policy anniversary at age 65 or end of premium payment term (whichever later).
benefits.notes: Brochure states minimum monthly income requirement applies; details in Product Summary.

evidence.quote:
Monthly payout in your golden years
Support your retirement with the Income Payout Option7, which converts your policy’s cash value into monthly payouts
that are payable to you until you reach age 99.

The policyholder may exercise the Income Payout Option at each monthly anniversary date starting from
(i) the policy anniversary when the Life Assured is age 65 or
(ii) the end of the premium payment term, whichever is later.
The monthly income will start one month after this option is exercised and it must meet the minimum monthly income requirement.

benefits.benefit_name: Guaranteed Extra Protection Option (purchase non-participating level term Supplementary Benefit)
benefits.benefit_description: Allows the policyholder to increase death and Terminal Illness coverage at key life stage events by purchasing a new non-participating level term Supplementary Benefit for extra premium (without providing evidence of insurability).
benefits.trigger_description: Exercisable at key life stage events including change of marital status, becoming a parent, tertiary education enrolment, full-time employment within one year from tertiary graduation, and purchasing a property.
covered_conditions: Becoming a parent (newborn or legal adoption)
Tertiary education enrolment (Life Assured or child)
Full-time employment within one year from tertiary graduation
benefits.payout_basis: purchase additional Supplementary Benefit coverage (level term) on death and Terminal Illness
benefits.payout_description: Allows policyholder to purchase a new non-participating level term Supplementary Benefit for coverage on death and Terminal Illness with extra premium payable; total coverage under option is limited to 100% of Singlife Whole Life Choice’s Base Sum Assured or up to maximum S$500,000 per life (whichever is lower).
benefits.notes: Option is extended to standard life only; without providing evidence of insurability.

evidence.quote:
As your priorities change, the Guaranteed Extra Protection Option6 allows you to boost your coverage at important
life stages, like buying a property or having a child—without any additional health checks.
The policyholder may exercise the Guaranteed Extra Protection Option at any of the following key life stage events, without providing evidence of insurability:
This option allows the policyholder to purchase a new non-participating level term Supplementary Benefit for coverage on death and Terminal Illness with extra premium payable.

The total coverage that can be taken up under this option is limited to 100% of Singlife Whole Life Choice’s Base Sum Assured, or up to a maximum of S$500,000 per life,
whichever is lower. This option is extended to standard life only.
